result.title: ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference
result.summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 LLM 推理的 test-time scaling，提出资源感知框架 ATEST，联合权衡额外采样的期望收益与当前 GPU 能耗；其在线模式增量采样、估计多数答案的稳定性、监控实时 GPU 负载并在线学习单步能耗，从而决定何时停止。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本 LLM 场景，但基于答案稳定性的在线停止准则与能耗/负载建模，可为 LVR 中 STOP 决策及动态计算成本权衡提供可核查的方法线索，其能否迁移到多模态与 latent 推理状态仍需验证。
